G-007.phase: Phase 6: inventory, purchasing, receiving, reservations, replenishment, material traceability, remnants, scrap and interbranch transfer
G-007.statusNote: Phase 6: a transfer is shipped, is in transit and is received. Sending puts the item's free quantity in an in-transit bucket at the sending branch (reservations and holds travel with it); it cannot be sold, reserved, cut, corrected or sent again. The receiving branch books it in; anything short, missing or damaged is held with a note until a manager or the inventory manager settles it. The sender can call it back before it arrives. Tables StockTransfer and StockTransferLine, column Inventory.qtyInTransit, and the balance identity now includes in transit (SQL Editor file 12).
G-007.verification: qa/sim/phase6-inventory.mjs: the 17 "Interbranch transfers" scenarios and the transfer scenarios under "Concurrency, security and recovery"; qa/sim/ui-phase6.cjs: transfers received from the screen; src/backend/test/phase6Rules.test.js (4 tests); qa/tools/db-facts.mjs: five transfer checks at 0. Older suites updated to ship then receive (phase-06-regression-results.md).

I-007.phase: Phase 6: inventory, purchasing, receiving, reservations, replenishment, material traceability, remnants, scrap and interbranch transfer
I-007.statusNote: Phase 6, under owner decision 4 (build every sample module): purchase orders are written and placed by a buyer or the inventory manager, a receipt names the line it fills, the line counts what came (in its own unit: LB, CWT, TON or pieces), and a receipt that does not match the line (grade, product, size, over-receipt, certificate required but not on file) is received on hold with every reason. A purchase order with receipts is closed, not cancelled. No approval rule was invented (K-011). Matching the supplier's invoice is K-012.
I-007.verification: qa/sim/phase6-inventory.mjs: the 16 "Purchasing and replenishment" scenarios, "two receipts against the same purchase order line at once both count"; qa/sim/ui-phase6.cjs: purchase order and receiving checks; qa/tools/db-facts.mjs: purchase order receipt checks at 0.

C-011.phase: Phase 6: inventory, purchasing, receiving, reservations, replenishment, material traceability, remnants, scrap and interbranch transfer
C-011.statusNote: Phase 6: shelf goods are received by the piece (form SUPPLY) against a product in the catalog, with no heat or grade; the stock is counted in EA. A database check (Coil_heat_and_grade_unless_supply, SQL Editor file 12) keeps heat and grade required for every other form. The counter sale and its void already move piece stock (Phase 2 and 5).
